items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
items.summary: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. items.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
items.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. items.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
items.summary: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other data.
